main_body: A brown wooden block-like composite object: a left rectangular panel and a taller central brown mass with a tan lower-right section, all outlined in near-black. It reads as flat brown fills with no distinct top surface.
top_band: none; the central column starts with a small tan patch at rows 1-2 that is only a highlight, and the left block has a few tan dashes. No consistent lighter horizontal band sits above a front face.
evidence: A pixel column through the middle of the central body (x~20) goes from dark outline at row 0 to a mid-brown fill for the whole height, with no lighter top band, no front-edge line and no eave shadow. The left block is the same: uniform brown with a few tan dashes at rows 4, 8, 14. The tan region at lower right is a flat vertical fill. This is a front elevation with no horizontal surface visible from above.

style.evidence: The candidate has large flat areas of one brown, plus a tan patch, with a thick near-black outline around every shape. It has only about 2-3 tones against the references' 5-6 steps and texture dots. Tiles carry 2-4 colours, well below the stall and well references. It reads as a sticker-like silhouette.
